name: Knot inner half: quest areas
notes: The main quest's inner Knot areas in the knot-inner scene (mw-e26.10, mw-5wg). The player-filtered volumes `horns-hall`, `the-fold` and `the-cradle` are the quest areas of those ids (reach-horns-hall, the Fold objective, reach-the-cradle). The quest reads them, so they are not wired. The Sounding Shaft's top volume (`sounding-shaft-top`) belongs to the priory's belfry deck and the shaft climb (mw-e26.18).
